anchor.description: Where a floating object sits: the top-left corner is `dx`,`dy` from the top-left corner of `cell`; the size is `width` x `height`. All four in points (1/72 inch), x to the right, y downwards.

cell.description: The cell the object is pinned to.

dx.description: Horizontal offset from the cell's left edge, points.

dy.description: Vertical offset from the cell's top edge, points.

mode.description: What happens when rows or columns under the object move or resize. MoveAndSize: it moves and stretches with them. MoveOnly: it moves, keeps its size. Absolute: it stays where it is on the sheet.

cell_ref.description: One cell of the grid, by ZERO-BASED row and column: the cell written `A1` is {"row": 0, "col": 0}, `C7` is {"row": 6, "col": 2}.

col.description: Zero-based column index, 0..16383 (the grid has 16,384 columns; column 0 is `A`, 25 is `Z`, 26 is `AA`).

row.description: Zero-based row index, 0..1048575 (the grid has 1,048,576 rows).

color.description: A colour: automatic, an explicit RGB value, or a slot of the workbook theme with a tint.

oneOf.description: Automatic: black for text and lines, no fill for fills.

Rgb.description: 0xRRGGBB packed in one integer: red*65536 + green*256 + blue, each component 0..255, sRGB.

oneOf.description: A theme colour with a tint.

Theme.description: [slot, tint]. slot: index 0..255 into `theme.colors` of the styles node (0 = light 1 / background, 1 = dark 1 / text, 2 = light 2, 3 = dark 2, 4..9 = accent 1..6, 10 = hyperlink, 11 = followed hyperlink; a slot beyond 11 resolves to black). tint: -1000..1000 thousandths; 0 = the theme colour itself. To resolve: convert the theme colour to HSL; if tint < 0 then L' = L * (1 + tint/1000), else L' = L * (1 - tint/1000) + tint/1000; convert back to RGB.

range_ref.description: A rectangle of cells, both corners INCLUDED. `start` is the top-left corner and `end` the bottom-right one (start.row <= end.row and start.col <= end.col; a reader that finds them swapped swaps them back). A whole row spans columns 0..16383; a whole column spans rows 0..1048575.

description: One chart (node type core.sheet.chart). The chart is described, not drawn: it names the cell ranges it plots, and a reader draws it from the cells.

anchor.description: Where the chart floats on its sheet.

by_rows.description: The series are the ROWS of `source` (false: its columns).

data_labels.description: Values are written beside the data points.

gridlines.description: Major gridlines of the value axis are drawn.

id.description: Object id, unique among the objects of the workbook.

kind.description: The chart type. Column = vertical bars, Bar = horizontal bars; Stacked100 = stacked to 100%. Combo: each series says how it is drawn.

pivot.description: For a PivotChart: its PivotTable as `SheetName!PivotTableName`; the series are rebuilt from that report. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

series.description: The data series, in plot order.

bubble_sizes.description: Bubble charts: the bubble sizes as reference text. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

categories.description: The category labels (x values for scatter and bubble charts) as reference text, e.g. `Sheet1!$A$2:$A$9`. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

color.description: Series colour; `null` = automatic (from the chart style).

kind.description: Combo charts: how this series is drawn; `null` = like the chart.

name.description: Series name: a cell reference as text (`Sheet1!$B$1`) or a literal. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

secondary.description: Combo charts: drawn against the secondary value axis.

smooth.description: Line segments are drawn as a smoothed curve.

backward.description: Forecast before the first point, in x units.

dash.description: Line dash (the DrawingML preset dashes); `null` = default.

display_equation.description: The equation is shown on the chart.

display_r_squared.description: R squared is shown on the chart.

forward.description: Forecast beyond the last point, in x units.

intercept.description: Fixed y value at x = 0; `null` = fitted.

oneOf.description: Linear y = m*x + b; Exponential y = c*e^(b*x); Logarithmic y = c*ln(x) + b; Power y = c*x^b.

name.description: Legend name; `null` = automatic. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

values.description: The plotted values as reference text, e.g. `Sheet1!$B$2:$B$9`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

source.description: The range the chart was created from, as reference text. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

style.description: Number of the chart style (colour scheme) in the application's gallery.

title.description: Chart title. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

x_title.description: Title of the category (x) axis. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

y_title.description: Title of the value (y) axis. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

title: core.sheet.chart - one chart
